newsitem.title: ITALY: IFAD agrees $12 million aid loan with Benin.
newsitem.headline: IFAD agrees $12 million aid loan with Benin.

text.p: The International Fund for Agricultural Development said on Tuesday it had signed a $12 million loan with Benin to help finance a scheme to boost smallholder incomes, food security and environmental protection.

The Rome-based group said in a statement the project, which will affect the south of the country, will mostly benefit landless rural smallholders whose precarious livelihood is based on rural wage labour and subsistence agricutlure.
The project will bring IFAD's total assistance to Benin to $58 million, the statement said.
